Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
The thick walls of the "basket" where the grates and gas burners give me confidence that they will not burn through anytime soon.  This is about the 5th gas grill I have owned over the years and the walls have always burned through with time which leads me to conclude they were a total waste of money.  Indeed, 99% of all the grills on the market today are constructed just like the ones I had which burned through.  This weber has thick walls (cast aluminum?) which will most likely never burn through on me.

The design of the grill which include the burners, control knobs, tank location, tool hooks, and side surface areas are beautifully laid out for "user friendly" grilling.  I find it very natural to use...almost intuitive.  I love this grill!   I should have purchased a Weber years ago!

While putting it together, I also found Weber's Customer Service people on top of their game, allowing me to assemble the grill flawlessly.  My vote is for Weber!
Results.Title: Perfect!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill.  We are a family of 3 - it is a perfect size for us.  With plenty of room if we have company to load up.  Best grill I have ever purchased.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Bought my first Weber two months ago and couldn’t be happier . After having owned bigger , less expensive ones , it goes to show big isn’t always better. Now I realize what a quality grill should cook like
Results.Title: Amazing

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I purchased a unit still in the box so I could assemble it myself and see exactly how this product goes together.  The grill component construction is very robust and the assembly instructions were easy to follow.  I have owned many grills over the years but this is my first Weber.  Of all the features what I like best is the absence of "hot spots" when I am grilling.  The heat is relatively uniform across the grate surface, which is a most welcome change from past grills I have used.
Results.Title: Best grill ever

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have had this for about 4 months and I absolutely love this grill!
Results.Title: Simple Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is the most even cooking grill I have ever used. The quality and craftsmanship in it’s construction is outstanding. Looking forward to many years of great food coming off this grill
Results.Title: Awesome Grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I also own an E-310 that I'm very happy with. I bought the E-210 for our winter home; we have less room for storage so I thought the smaller unit would work out better and I've not been disappointed. I've done ribs, pork chops, burgers and steaks and had great results. Easy to clean, easy to use and very well made. I have just one complaint that prevents a 5 star rating: the foldable side table occasionally slips out of it's mounting when using it to lift and roll the unit into position or storage (the E-310 has the same issue). It would be perfect if that were a bit more secure. Nonetheless, I would certainly buy another, although it's well enough made that I doubt I will ever need to.
Results.Title: Very happy with this unit, well made, easy to use.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We purchased this through Lowes 3 months ago and they assembled and delivered it, after reading the manual I tried it out and Presto it worked as you said it would! This is my 3rd Weber and the first two were damaged by storms I am a firm believer in your fine product !
Results.Title: Love the look and performance of this product !

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I Grill 2 to 3 times a week. Best grill I have ever owned.
Results.Title: Reliable

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
